Subject: Your divorce by mutual consent matter - Petition No. 2234/2024

Dear Mr. Rao,

Thank you for meeting us on 09/11/2024 about your dispute with Pranav DSouza. As we understand it, both spouses have lived apart for a long time.

Our advice is to apply to waive the statutory cooling-off period. Please collect proof of separate residence and the consent terms and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of 10.2 lakh rupees.

Regards,
Adv. Tejas Oberoi
